questions.question_text: Situation 1: A box is 5 cm wide, 8 cm long, and 4 cm tall. What is its volume?
questions.question_text_th: Situation 1: A box is 5 cm wide, 8 cm long, and 4 cm tall. What is its volume?
questions.explanation: Volume = width x length x height = 5 x 8 x 4 = 160 cu cm
questions.explanation_th: Volume = width x length x height = 5 x 8 x 4 = 160 cu cm
questions.hint_th: Volume = width x length x height

questions.question_text_th: Situation 6: A cylindrical tank has diameter 2 m and height 3 m. What is its volume? (pi = 3.14)
